layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards, gap-6 between dashboard widgets.

dashboard_cards.hover: hover:shadow-md hover:border-[#D1CCC2] transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out hover:-translate-y-0.5

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E5E2DC]

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and interactive cards must have scale-up or shadow changes.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in from bottom with opacity.

components_strategy.buttons: Shadcn based. Primary buttons use #4A6D5C background with white text. Rounded full.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn based. bg-white border-[#E5E2DC] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4A6D5C]/20 focus:border-[#4A6D5C].
components_strategy.tables: Go cardless for raw data rows or use a clean border-bottom for each row. Use Shadcn Table.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn charts or Recharts. Use brand and semantic colors (Income: #3D8B61, Expense: #E63946).
components_strategy.dialogs: Shadcn dialogs for Add Transaction, rounded-2xl with p-6.
components_strategy.badges: For categories. Soft backgrounds with solid text (e.g., bg-[#E9F5EF] text-[#3D8B61]).

icons.style: Clean, line-based, 2px stroke width. Contextual colors (red for expenses, green for income).

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-transaction-button', data-testid='submit-transaction', data-testid='profile-switch').

auth_background.description: Warm crumpled paper lantern lighting, used as a subtle background for the Login/Register page.

default_avatar.description: Professional user portrait to be used as default avatar in header and profile section.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Use Vite + React + Tailwind + Shadcn. Initialize Shadcn components: table, card, button, input, dialog, select, dropdown-menu, tabs, chart.
instructions_to_main_agent.features: 1. Build an Auth page with the auth_background image. 2. Build a Dashboard layout with a sidebar or sticky header. 3. Implement widgets: Balance, Income, Expenses, Savings. 4. Implement a Main Chart (Area or Bar) for cash flow. 5. Implement Recent Transactions list with category icons. 6. Build the 'Add Transaction' flow with AI receipt scanning UI placeholder.
instructions_to_main_agent.design_rules: Respect the organic & earthy color palette. Use ample padding (p-6, p-8) to make it feel premium. Follow the 'Control Room Grid' for the dashboard layout. Do not use generic blue SaaS colors. Every interactive element must include a data-testid.
